predecessor: S112 EXTERNAL rejected at development (stress: 52 fills, PF 0.82, mean -0.139R). Diagnostics on the burned S112 development trades: 18 of 41 stopped trades never reached +0.5R (false sweeps); 6 reached 2-3R before stopping; 47 of 165 limits expired; 39 signals blocked by the single position/pending slot.
hypothesis: A sweep into demand is a real reversal only if sellers were absorbed or positions were flushed. Requiring that evidence, plus a 4h discount location, removes false sweeps; a 50% scale-out at 2R captures trades that reach 2-3R and then fail.
selection_disclosure: Designed after inspecting S112 development results; the S112 development window is therefore in-sample for S113 and is reported only as a reference. Warmup-only feasibility (2024-08..2025-05, counts only, no PnL): 330 S112-EXTERNAL signals vs 101 S113 signals on 8 symbols (64 CVD divergence, 37 OI flush). Because 8 symbols could not reach a held-out sample, the universe is the predeclared 12-symbol S110 combined universe and the two held-out windows are pooled into one test.

data.klines: Binance public USD-M checksumed 1m kline and funding archives
data.open_interest: Binance public USD-M daily metrics archives, 5m sum_open_interest; a sample is used only after its 5-minute period has ended
data.cvd: per 15m bar sum of (2 x taker_buy_volume - volume) from the 1m klines, cumulative

unchanged_from_s112: context, 1h OB zone, SSL sweep, MSS, FVG, maker limit at FVG proximal edge (240 min), stop beyond sweep extreme - 0.10 ATR (0.35-3.0 ATR), target = first 1h BSL with stress net R in [3, 10], max hold 72h, costs, risk 0.2%

added_filters.absorption: required: CVD at the sweep-extreme 15m bar > CVD at the swept swing-low pivot bar (cvd_divergence), OR open interest at the extreme bar close is >= 0.5% below the value one hour before the sweep bar opened (oi_flush)
added_filters.discount: sweep low <= low + 1/3 x (high - low) of the last 30 closed 4h bars known at the previous 15m close

capacity_change: maximum open positions 2 (S112: 1); still one pending limit globally

routes.CONTROL: S112 EXTERNAL rules with the S113 universe and capacity; not promotable, measures the filters' incremental effect
routes.ABSORB_PARTIAL: ABSORB + 50% scale-out at +2R gross from the limit price; stop never moved

multiple_testing: Two candidate routes (ABSORB, ABSORB_PARTIAL). Each must pass on its own; the held-out window is opened once for all routes.
after_pass: Shadow paper-forward only, alongside the mechanical baseline; no live approval.
